'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Freeman DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Freeman]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: You are neither hot nor cold.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' DarkLordOfTheSith
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
